_notice: Screen-detection predicates adapted from the herdr project (https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr, src/detect/manifests/*.toml), licensed Apache-2.0. Translated from herdr's TOML rule schema into Ubra's JSON predicate schema and re-prioritised for this engine; the agent capability block is Ubra's own.

agent._resumeNotice: Verified against Pi's official README: 'pi -c                  # Continue most recent session'. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/README.md. --session requires a path or id.
agent._resumeStyleNotice: Ubra pins Pi's fresh and continue commands to a per-session provider directory, so `-c` cannot accidentally select another Ubra session's latest conversation.

_statusNotice: Rules written for Pi 0.73-0.99 from its TUI source (pi-tui Loader, CustomEditor.renderTopBorder, ExtensionSelector/ExtensionInput) and verified against the real CLI in tests/pi_real.rs. Pi draws its working, retry and compaction indicators as a braille spinner frame, embedded in the composer's top border since 0.9x; agent- or extension-raised questions (project trust, ctx.ui.select/confirm/input) carry a '↑↓ navigate' or 'enter submit' hint; the idle composer is a bare full-width rule. Pi has no built-in tool approvals.
